scenarios.scenario: Open the Sketch Create panel expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with `Sketch1` being edited in the MCAD Software
the Sketch ribbon is expanded and the Create panel is visible
the Create panel's additional command area is closed
the user selects the expansion arrow on the Create panel title
an additional command area opens below that panel over the workspace
the Create Block command is visible
Precise Input is visible but unavailable in this captured state
the sketch and model browser remain visible
the user presses Escape
the Create additional command area remains open
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Create additional command area closes
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Open and close the Sketch Constrain panel expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the Sketch ribbon is expanded and the Constrain panel is visible
the Constrain panel's additional command area is closed
the user opens the Constrain panel expansion
an additional command area opens below the panel over the workspace
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are visible
the sketch and model browser remain visible
the user presses Escape
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Constrain additional command area closes
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Inspect a command context menu in the Sketch Constrain expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area is open
the user right-clicks Edit Coordinate System
the command context menu lists Ribbon Appearance, Add to Quick Access Toolbar, Move to Main Panel, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user presses Escape
the command context menu closes
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the Edit Coordinate System help tooltip appears while the pointer remains over that command
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss Show Panels from the expanded Constrain command menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area is open
the user right-clicks Edit Coordinate System
the user opens Show Panels
Sketch, Create, Modify, Pattern, Constrain, Insert and Format are checked
Layout and Parameters are unchecked
the user presses Escape
the Show Panels submenu closes and the command context menu remains open
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user presses Escape again
the command context menu and Constrain additional command area close
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Switch ribbon tabs with the Sketch Constrain context menu open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area is open
the user right-clicks Edit Coordinate System
the command context menu is visible
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab
the command context menu and Constrain additional command area close
the full Tools ribbon is visible
sketch edit remains active
the user returns to the Sketch ribbon tab
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area remains closed
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Close an expanded Modify panel using its title

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model Modify panel is expanded and unpinned
the user clicks the Modify title at the bottom of the expanded area
the additional command area closes
the 3D Model ribbon and part remain visible
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model Modify panel's unpinned additional command area is open
the user clicks the Simplification panel expansion arrow
the Modify additional command area closes
the Simplification additional command area opens
it displays "Remove Details", "Fill Voids", and "Define Envelopes"
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the Simplification additional command area closes
the part and 3D Model ribbon remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch tabs after selecting the expansion pin

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model Modify additional command area is open
the user clicks its pin control
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab
the Modify additional command area is no longer visible
the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab
the Modify additional command area is not automatically displayed
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the additional command area closes
